segments.sn35.122:1.3: Katame ca, bhikkhave, saṃyojaniyā dhammā, katamañca saṃyojanaṃ?
segments.sn35.122:1.4: Santi, bhikkhave, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn35.122:1.6: Yo tattha chandarāgo, taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ…pe…
segments.sn35.122:1.8: santi, bhikkhave, manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn35.122:1.10: Yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha saṃyojana”nti.

lines: Navamadasamāni iṭṭhārammaṇavasena kathiyamāne bujjhanakānaṃ vasena vuttānīti.
